[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant mentioned the 80/20 rule, stating that 80% of the time, one likely wears 20% of their clothes.

[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant suggested grouping similar items together and organizing by occasion or color.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant recommended using storage containers for items like socks, underwear, and accessories.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant advised hanging clothes in a logical order and using double hangers to maximize space.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant suggested designating a "launching pad" for daily outfit planning.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant emphasized the importance of maintaining the organized closet weekly.

[USER] The user asked for advice on deciding what to keep and what to donate or discard.
